kind_seeds.purpose: Resume a session when its coord gate clears (incl. stall re-dispatch and re-target).
Dispatch a work unit to a device as a fresh session.
Autonomously continue a stale session from its resolved next step.
Spawn a fixer for a PR diagnosed as needing author rework.
Spawn a fixer for a repo whose main branch is red.
Run a condition group's audit on its schedule or trigger.
Audit a newly connected repo to propose a starter merge profile.

class_seeds.reason: The runner's no-row branch for this class already ALLOWS, so a row would change no behaviour while adding a lever nobody asked for. Recorded here rather than left as an absent literal so a test can assert the omission is deliberate.

class_seeds.purpose: Class-level opt-in for parallel fan-out spawns, and the row that exposes the fan-out bound the served policy promises is user-declared (`bound declared up front (registry default 15)`). Disabling it degrades ALL parallel fan-out to inline for every agent without its own parallel_fanout row.

Class-level opt-in for every coord-initiated spawn that outlives the request. Resolved by runner funnel sites that carry no agent name (a gate continuation carries a gate_id, not an agent); disabling it stops ALL standing spawns on devices that reach this door.
